name: Claude Whiteboard (board artifact type)
what: A shared infinite board of shapes, arrows, sections, tables, text, hand-style drawings and small embeds that people rearrange together live. It serves sitemaps, user flows, journey maps, brainstorms, votes and rough storyboards.
install: No install line. Artifacts and the Whiteboard template must be on for the claude.ai account; on Team and Enterprise an organization Owner enables them in organization settings. In Claude Code, sign in with /login and a claude.ai account.
firstCall: Artifact quickstart with intent 'other' when the host offers it, else an Artifact types list, to get the type link; then read the type's SKILL.md that the create call returns
evidenceNote: Artifact read calls on the type's SKILL.md and drawing file succeeded. Public Help Center pages on artifacts were read. NOT exercised: creating a board, any ArtifactData write, a claim, a drawing, an export, the Canva import. No export path and no design system use are documented. No per-call credits; work draws from the shared plan usage pool.
